attributes.apc_flag: Validated AEMO administered-price-cap flag from the same regional interval record, or null when unproven.
attributes.control_authority: Always false; market observations cannot authorize any hardware command.
attributes.data_source: Exact official AEMO DispatchIS report URL for an accepted authoritative observation; the official report index URL before a successful fetch, or the explicit summary source for diagnostic-only observations.
attributes.declared_event_confirmed: Always false; a wholesale opportunity is not a confirmed retailer or VPP event.
attributes.error: Exception class describing a failed feed request, or null.
attributes.export_threshold_per_kwh: Configured strict wholesale-price threshold for a possible export opportunity, in AUD/kWh.
attributes.first_seen_at: UTC timestamp of this monitor's first accepted observation of the regional interval, preserved across repeated polls and corrections.
attributes.import_threshold_per_kwh: Explicit optional strict wholesale-price threshold for a possible import opportunity, in AUD/kWh; null disables import inference.
attributes.interval_end: Exclusive UTC end of the five-minute NEM interval, interpreted from fixed AEST source time.
attributes.interval_start: Inclusive UTC start of the same five-minute NEM interval.
attributes.intervention: Intervention flag from the authoritative dispatch record; zero is required for price-trigger authority, and null represents unverified provenance.
attributes.latency_basis: Always first_observation_after_interval_start; this measures observation delay and is not an AEMO publication timestamp.
attributes.latency_seconds: Elapsed seconds from interval start to this monitor's first accepted observation, or null when unproven.
attributes.market_suspended_flag: Validated AEMO market-suspension flag from the same regional interval record, or null when unproven.
attributes.payment_confirmed: Always false; no retailer payment eligibility or event credit is established by this monitor.
attributes.persistence_status: Local observation-history and notification-deduplication storage status; independent of electrical-ledger persistence.
attributes.price_per_kwh: Finite validated current wholesale price in AUD/kWh, converted from the same record's AUD/MWh value; null when no current numeric evidence is available.
attributes.price_per_mwh: Finite validated current wholesale price in AUD/MWh from the coherent regional record, or null.
attributes.price_status: AEMO price status from the same interval; FIRM is required for accepted numeric observations.
attributes.price_trigger_valid: Whether current source provenance, interval freshness, intervention and market flags qualify this observation as an input to price-trigger admission; all inverter and protected-energy gates remain independent.
attributes.price_unit: Always AUD/kWh, explicitly identifying the price and threshold unit used for possible-opportunity comparisons.
attributes.recent_observation_count: Count of retained bounded observations; detailed history is available in diagnostics rather than recurring entity attributes.
attributes.region: Explicitly configured NEM region; never inferred from electrical telemetry or site location.
attributes.source_fresh: Whether the original source interval is current; fetching an old report again cannot renew this evidence.
attributes.source_kind: Provenance classification dispatchis, summary or unverified; summary and unverified observations cannot admit automatic export.
attributes.source_url: Exact source URL retained with the observation, including the accepted official DispatchIS report URL; data_source remains its compatibility alias.
attributes.status: Current monitor reason or possible-opportunity state, identical to the AEMO Event Monitor entity state.
attributes.successful_fetch_at: UTC timestamp of the latest successful report fetch; repeated fetches cannot refresh the market interval's validity.

entities.definition: Independent read-only AEMO monitor reason and possible wholesale opportunity for the explicitly configured current regional interval; it confirms neither a retailer event nor payment and grants no hardware authority.
entities.producer: AemoMarketMonitor.current_result.status via AemoMonitorSensor.native_value; independent public-feed coordinator, not EnergyCoordinator or the electrical ledger
entities.unit_and_sign: No unit; stable reason states and possible opportunity classifications
entities.time_basis: Current five-minute NEM interval in fixed AEST, exposed as UTC start/end; validity expires at the exclusive interval end, independently of repeated polling
entities.availability: Always available so disabled, unconfigured, invalid, unavailable and expired feed reasons remain visible; electrical-ledger health does not determine availability.
entities.state_vocabulary: disabled, unconfigured, invalid_configuration, awaiting_data, watching, possible_export_event, possible_import_event, invalid_payload, missing_region, duplicate_region, invalid_interval, future, stale, invalid_price, unknown_price_status, invalid_market_flags, market_suspended, administered_pricing, unavailable

entities.definition: Validated current regional AEMO wholesale price from one coherent price, interval and status record; this is market evidence and is neither a household tariff nor a payable retailer event.
entities.producer: AemoMarketMonitor.current_result.price_per_kwh via AemoMonitorSensor.native_value; independent public-feed coordinator, not EnergyCoordinator or the electrical ledger
entities.unit_and_sign: AUD/kWh; positive and negative wholesale prices retain their source sign; no import/export energy direction is implied
entities.time_basis: Current five-minute NEM interval; source SETTLEMENTDATE is the exclusive interval end in fixed AEST even when local civil time uses daylight saving
entities.availability: Available only while current_result has a validated finite numeric price within its exact interval; malformed, future, expired or unavailable evidence yields unavailable. Valid suspended or administered-price observations remain diagnostic and cannot produce an opportunity.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite numeric current wholesale price or unavailable

entities.definition: Persistent operator request to enable read-only AEMO price monitoring for an explicit regional configuration; it cannot request battery, inverter or EV action.
entities.producer: EnergyCoordinator.runtime_config.aemo_monitor.enabled via AemoMonitorSwitch.is_on; saved market configuration only, independent of the electrical ledger
entities.unit_and_sign: No unit; on requests price monitoring and off pauses it
entities.time_basis: Current saved integration configuration, updated independently of electrical-ledger refreshes
entities.availability: Always available independently of market-feed outages and electrical-telemetry health; enabling requires a valid explicit NEM region and compatible finite thresholds.

entities.definition: Explicit NEM region selected for the independent price monitor; clearing the region removes that market mapping and is never replaced by an inferred site location.
entities.producer: EnergyCoordinator.runtime_config.aemo_monitor.region via AemoRegionSelect.current_option; saved market configuration only
entities.unit_and_sign: No unit; explicit region code or Not configured
entities.availability: Always available independently of feed and electrical-ledger health; unsupported values are rejected and changing region restarts only market observation validity.
entities.state_vocabulary: Not configured, NSW1, QLD1, VIC1, SA1, TAS1

entities.definition: Persistent wholesale-price threshold above which a validated current interval may be labelled a possible supply opportunity; it neither sets an export price nor confirms a payable retailer event.
entities.producer: EnergyCoordinator.runtime_config.aemo_monitor.export_threshold_per_kwh via AemoThresholdNumber.native_value; saved market configuration only
entities.time_basis: Current saved integration configuration; strict price greater-than comparison
entities.availability: Always available independently of feed and electrical-ledger health; box input from 0.001 to 100 AUD/kWh in 0.001 steps, with the optional consumption threshold strictly below it.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite positive saved threshold; existing configuration values are retained independently of dashboard editor bounds

entities.definition: Optional persistent wholesale-price threshold below which a validated current interval may be labelled a possible consumption opportunity; an absent threshold disables this inference and does not imply a free-power window or reward.
entities.producer: EnergyCoordinator.runtime_config.aemo_monitor.import_threshold_per_kwh via AemoThresholdNumber.native_value; saved market configuration only
entities.unit_and_sign: AUD/kWh; positive or negative wholesale threshold retaining its sign, with no household energy direction implied
entities.time_basis: Current saved integration configuration; strict price less-than comparison
entities.availability: Always available independently of feed and electrical-ledger health; box input from -100 to 100 AUD/kWh in 0.001 steps must remain strictly below the supply threshold. An absent value stays explicitly unset.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite saved threshold strictly below the supply threshold, or unset; existing configuration values are retained independently of dashboard editor bounds

entities.definition: Explicit operator action to clear the saved consumption opportunity threshold and disable import-opportunity inference; it performs no hardware operation and leaves supply monitoring configuration intact.
entities.producer: AemoClearImportThresholdButton.async_press persists an absent consumption threshold through _update_settings
entities.unit_and_sign: No unit; a press clears optional threshold configuration
entities.time_basis: Explicit operator invocation recorded by Home Assistant
entities.availability: Always available independently of market-feed outages and electrical-ledger health.
entities.state_vocabulary: Home Assistant button press timestamp or unknown before the first press
